Subject: Discovery recap & next steps — Northbridge Analytics

Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned: 

- Goal: Reduce per-token inference cost while meeting sub-150ms tail latency for customer-facing search.
- Primary users: product search team (400k queries/day peak), initial scope = search ranking/assist.
- Success metrics: 20-30% cost reduction vs current setup, maintain <=150ms p95 end-to-end.
- Constraints: must run in GCP us-west with VPC peering; SOC2 data handling required.

Proposed next steps:
1) I can put together a short POC plan (2-week pilot) with target metrics and test dataset.
2) Share a one-pager and ballpark pricing for Dedicated vs Hosted routing options.
3) If this looks good, schedule a 30-min technical kickoff with your infra lead and our solutions engineer.

Attachments: discovery-notes-20260310.pdf (notes from today)

Do these next steps make sense? If so, what’s the best week for a kickoff (we’ve got availability the weeks of Mar 22 or Apr 5)?

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
